---
We support documents for individuals from more than 200 countries. Depending on the selected country, the following information becomes available.

* **Supported ID and address documents**. Show the list of supported identity (PoI) and address (PoA) documents. You can also configure individual settings for supported [PoI](doc:customize-supported-id-documents) and [PoA](doc:customize-supported-address-documents) documents to streamline your operations for efficient document verification. To learn more about the general document requirements, see [ID document requirements](doc:how-id-verification-works#document-requirements) and [address document requirements](doc:how-address-verification-works#document-requirements).
* **Non-Doc Verification**. Lists what needs to be provided for [Non-Doc Verification](doc:no-document-verification) — a secure method to verify your applicants through government databases and official bank verification systems without documents.

        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="afg_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'afg_poi')" />
            <label for="afg_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="afg_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>پاسپورټ (Passport) – full spread</li>
                    <li>دیپلوماتیک پاسپورت (Diplomatic passport) – full spread</li>
                    <li>پېژندپاڼه (ID card) – back side required</li>
                    <li>دچلولواجازت پاڼه (Driver license) – back side are required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="afg_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'afg_poa')" />

    <div id="AlandIslands" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="alisl_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'alisl_poi')" />
            <label for="alisl_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="alisl_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Pass (Passport) – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (HENKILÖKORTTI) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Körkort (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Uppehållstillstånd (Residence Permit) – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="alisl_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'alisl_poa')" />
            <label for="alisl_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="alisl_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

            <label for="asm_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="asm_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>

                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>

    <div id="Armenia" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="arm_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'arm_poi')" />
            <label for="arm_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="arm_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Non-citizenship certificate - full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Refugee ID – front side, notarized translation required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="arm_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'arm_poa')" />
            <label for="arm_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="arm_poa">

            <label for="abw_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="abw_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (Cedula de Identidad) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="aus_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'aus_poi')" />
            <label for="aus_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="aus_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Travel document – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Firearms License – front side</li>
                        <li>Photo Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Proof of Age Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Keypass ID – front side</li>
                        <li>High Risk Work License – back side required</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Contractor licence – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>New South Wales – front side</li>
                        <li>Queensland – front side</li>
                        <li>South Australia – front side</li>
                        <li>Tasmania – front side</li>
                        <li>Victoria – front side</li>
                        <li>Western Australia – front side</li>
                        <li>Northern Territory – back side required</li>
                        <li>Australian Capital Territory – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="aus_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'aus_poa')" />
            <label for="aus_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>

    <div id="Austria" class="info">

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="aut_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'aut_poi')" />
            <label for="aut_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="aut_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Reisepass (Passport) – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Notpass (Emergency passport) – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Reiseausweis für Flüchtlinge (Refugee passport) – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Emergency Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (Personalausweis) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Flüchtlingsausweis (Refugee ID) (grey) – front side</li>
                        <li>Diplomatenausweis (Diplomatic ID) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Behindertenausweis (Disabled person card) – front side</li>
                        <li>Waffenbesitzkarte (Firearms license) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Führerschein (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Aufenthaltstitel (Residence permit) – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="aze_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'aze_poi')" />
            <label for="aze_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="aze_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (Vətəndaşının şəxsiyyət vəsiqəsi) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Refugee ID - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="aze_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'aze_poa')" />

            <label for="bhs_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="bhs_poi">

                <ul>

                    <li>Voter Card – front side</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>

                    </ul>

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bgd_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'bgd_poi')" />
            <label for="bgd_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="bgd_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (জাতীয় পরিচয় পত্র) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Disabled Person ID – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Temporary NID - back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>E-Paper Driving License - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bgd_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'bgd_poa')" />

    <div id="Barbados" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="brb_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'brb_poi')" />
            <label for="brb_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="brb_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

    <div id="Belarus" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="blr_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'blr_poi')" />
            <label for="blr_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="blr_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>ID Card (ІДЭНТЫФІКАЦЫЙНАЯ КАРТКА) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Army / Military ID Card – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="blr_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'blr_poa')" />
            <label for="blr_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="blr_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

    <div id="Belgium" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bel_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'bel_poi')" />
            <label for="bel_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="bel_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Paspoort / Passeport / Reisepass (Passport) – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>Elektronische identiteitskaart / Carte d'identité / eID (Identity card) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Carte d'identité diplomatique (spéciale) – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Rijbewijs / Permis de conduire / Führerschein (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Provisoir document / Document provisoire (Provisional document) – front side</li>
                    <li>Verblijfsvergunning / Permis de séjour / Aufenthaltserlaubnis (Residence permit) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>E-kaart (EU-burger) / Carte E (Citoyen de l'UE) / E-Karte (EU-Bürger) (E Card / EU Citizen) – back side required</li>
                        <li>F-kaart (Familielid van EU-burger) / Carte F (Membre de la famille d'un citoyen de l'UE) / F-Karte (Familienangehöriger eines EU-Bürgers) (F Card / Member of EU Citizen Family) – back side required</li>
                        <li>E Plus-kaart (EU-burger) / Carte E Plus (Citoyen de l'UE) / E Plus-Karte (EU-Bürger) (E Plus Card / EU Citizen) – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bel_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'bel_poa')" />
            <label for="bel_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>

    <div id="Belize" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="blz_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'blz_poi')" />
            <label for="blz_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="blz_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary Passport - biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Social Security Card - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
                <ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit - back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="blz_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'blz_poa')" />
            <label for="blz_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="blz_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    </li2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

    <div id="Benin" class="info">

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ben_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'ben_poi')" />
            <label for="ben_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ben_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Paspo (Passport) – full spread</li>
                    <li>Carte nationale d'identité (National ID) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Carte d'électeur (Voter ID) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Carte d'identité de la CEDEAO (ECOWAS ID) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Certificate D’Identification Personnelle – front side</li>
                        <li>Carte d'identité consulaire (Consul ID) – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Permis de conduire (Driver license) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Permis de séjour (Residence permit) – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ben_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'ben_poa')" />

    <div id="Bhutan" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="btn_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'btn_poi')" />
            <label for="btn_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="btn_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>Citizenship Card (མི་ཁུངས་ལག་ཁྱེར།) – back side require</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Voter ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Citizenship Card – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit - back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="btn_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'btn_poa')" />
            <label for="btn_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="btn_poa">

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

    <div id="Botswana" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bwa_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'bwa_poi')" />
            <label for="bwa_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="bwa_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>NATIONAL IDENTITY CARD – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bwa_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'bwa_poa')" />
            <label for="bwa_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="bwa_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                    </li2>

                        </svg>

                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We do not accept the following documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>

    <div id="Brazil" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bra_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'bra_poi')" />
            <label for="bra_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="bra_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>Сarteira de identidade (Cédula de identidad) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Brazilian Identity Card (cédula de identidade, RG) – back side required, digital version supported</li>
                        <li>Public Prosecutor's Office Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Bar Association of Brazil Сard – back side required</li>
                        <li>COFECI/CRECI System Сard – back side required</li>
                        <li>Civil Aviation Agency Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Civilian Police Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Consular ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Conselho Federal de Biologia – back side required</li>
                        <li>Council of Architecture and Urbanism of Brazil Сard – front side</li>
                        <li>Courts and Judges of the States, the Federal District and the Territories Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Council of Administration Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Council of Biomedicine Identity Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Federal Council of Chemistry Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Council of Dentistry Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Council of Engineering and Agronomy Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Council of Medicine Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Council of Nutritionists Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Council of Pharmacy Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Federal Council of Physical Education Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Council of Veterinary Medicine – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Court of Audits of the Federal District Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Highway Police Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Nursing Council Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal Police Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Federal and Regional Council of Dentistry Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Labor Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Member of Judiciary Special Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Military/Army/Air Force/Navy/Ministry of Defence ID Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Military Firefighter Corps Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Military Police Сard – back side required</li>
                        <li>Military Service Exemption Certificate – back side required</li>
                        <li>Municipal Guards Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>National Council of Radiology Technicians Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Poder Judiciário Tribunal de Justiça – back side required</li>
                        <li>Policia Civil – back side required</li>
                        <li>Refugee ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Regional Accounting Council Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Regional Administration Council Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Regional Council of Biology Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Regional Council of Economics Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Regional Council of Medicine of the State of Bahia Card - back side required</li>
                        <li>Regional Council of Physiotherapy and Occupational Therapy Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Regional Council of Psychology Сard – back side required</li>
                        <li>Regional Council of Speech Therapy Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Regional Council of Social Service Card - front side</li>
                        <li>Regional Labor Court Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Secretariat of Social Protection Сard – back side required</li>
                        <li>Secretary of Penitentiary Administration Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Secretary of State for Justice Identity Card – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) – back side required, digital version supported</li>
                        <li>Circulação Internacional de Automotores – back side required</li>
                        <li>Carteira de Habilitação do Amador – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Alien Identity Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>National Migration Registration Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Provisional National Migration Registration Document – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bra_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'bra_poa')" />
            <label for="bra_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="bra_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Consular ID
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Vehicle registration certificate (Certificado de Registro de Veículo)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Declaration of residence (Declaração de Residência)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Registration certificate (INSS - INSTITUTO NACIONAL DO SEGURO SOCIAL/CNIS/Dados Cadastrais)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Unemployment Insurance Application (Requerimento de Seguro Desemprego)
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We do not accept the following documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Old government-issued correspondence (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Old bank statements (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Old utility bills linked to the property (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Pension statements
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />

                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Medical bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Receipts for purchases
                    </li2>

    <div id="Bulgaria" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bgr_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'bgr_poi')" />
            <label for="bgr_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="bgr_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Passport of Subsidiary Protection Beneficiary - biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (ЛИЧНА КАРТА) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Refugee ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Card of Subsidiary Protection Beneficiary – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bgr_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'bgr_poa')" />
            <label for="bgr_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="bgr_poa">

                    </li2>

    <div id="BurkinaFaso" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bfa_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'bfa_poi')" />
            <label for="bfa_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="bfa_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>ID Card (CARTE NATIONALE D'IDENTITE) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Carte d'Electeur - back side required</li>
                        <li>Consular ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Military ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Professional ID – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="bfa_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'bfa_poa')" />
            <label for="bfa_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>

                    <ul>

                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="khm_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'khm_poi')" />
            <label for="khm_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="khm_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>លិខិតឆ្លង (Passport) – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>ប៉ាសុនម៉ាក្រូស្ពៃកម្ពុជា-ថៃ (Cambodia-Thailand Border Pass) – full spread</li>
                        <li>Official – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>អត្តសញ្ញណប័ណ្ណសញ្ជាតិខ្មែរ (ID card) – front side (in some cases, back side and notarized translation are required)</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>National Police Identity Card (translation required) - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ប័ណ្ណបើកបរ (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>កាតប៉ាន់ស្តង់សំរាប់អ្នកអបសេរី (Permanent resident card) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Foreign Employment Card – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

                        </svg>

                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />

    <div id="Cameroon" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="cmr_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'cmr_poi')" />
            <label for="cmr_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="cmr_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>African Union Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Foreign – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (CARTE NATIONALE D'IDENTITE) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Consul ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Temporary ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Voter ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Police ID - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="cmr_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'cmr_poa')" />
            <label for="cmr_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="cmr_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        </svg>
                        Residence permit
                    </li2>
                </ul2>

    <div id="Canada" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="can_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'can_poi')" />
            <label for="can_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="can_poi">
                <blockquote>
                    <p>
                        In Canada, Health ID cards may not be recognized as identity documents, or may require additional legal justification to be accepted as proof of identity. You can disable these documents in the <a href="https://cockpit.sumsub.com/checkus/sdkIntegrations/globalSettings/userVerification/supportedIdDocuments">Supported ID Documents</a> settings.
                    </p>
                </blockquote>
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Aviation Document – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Foreign – full spread</li>
                        <li>Internal – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Refugee travel document – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Temporary Passport – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Canada - ID Card</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Firearms License – front side</li>
                        <li>Health ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Сertificate of Canadian Citizenship – front side</li>
                        <li>Alberta ID card – front side</li>
                        <li>British Columbia ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Manitoba ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>New Brunswick ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Newfoundland and Labrador ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Northwest territories ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Nova Scotia ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Nunavut ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Ontario ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Prince Edward Island ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Quebec ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Saskatchewan ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Yukon ID Card – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Canada - Driving License</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Alberta – front side</li>
                        <li>British Columbia – front side</li>
                        <li>Brunswick – front side</li>
                        <li>Manitoba – front side</li>
                        <li>National Defence – front side</li>
                        <li>Newfoundland and Labrador – front side</li>
                        <li>Northwest – front side</li>
                        <li>Nova Scotia – front side</li>
                        <li>Nunavut – front side</li>
                        <li>Ontario – front side</li>
                        <li>Prince Edward Island – front side</li>
                        <li>Quebec – front side</li>
                        <li>Saskatchewan – front side</li>
                        <li>Yukon – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <li>Refugee ID – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="can_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'can_poa')" />
            <label for="can_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="can_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>

                    <li2>

    <div id="Chile" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="chl_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'chl_poi')" />
            <label for="chl_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="chl_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Emergency Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (CÉDULA DE IDENTIDAD) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="chl_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'chl_poa')" />
            <label for="chl_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="chl_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="chn_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'chn_poi')" />
            <label for="chn_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="chn_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Foreign – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Passport for Public Affairs – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Travel Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Resident Identity Card (居 民 身 份 证) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary ID (临时居民身份证) - back side required</li>
                        <li>Travel Permit (港澳居民来往内地通行証) - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Ethnic minorities ID – back side required:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Korean</li>
                        <li>Mongolian</li>
                        <li>Nuosu Yi</li>
                        <li>Tibetan</li>
                        <li>Uyghur</li>
                        <li>Zhuang</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Mainland Travel Permit for Hong Kong and Macao citizens – back side required</li>
                        <li>Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Residence Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Zhejiang Province Residence Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Hong Kong Macao Pass – back side required</li>
                        <li>Taiwan Road Trip Permit – back side required</li>
                        <li>Taiwan Pass – back side required</li>
                        <li>Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents – back side required</li>
                        <li>Beijing Tong Residence Permit of Beijing – front side</li>
                        <li>Wuxi Residence Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Taiyuan Residence Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Sticker Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Shenzhen Residence Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Shanghai Residence Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Residence Permit for Taiwan Residents – back side required</li>
                        <li>Jiangsu Residence Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Guangdong Residence Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Fujian Residence Permit – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="chn_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'chn_poa')" />
            <label for="chn_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="chn_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>

                    <li2>

                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    </li2>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
