                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>

                        <li>Permiso Especial de Permanencia – front side</li>

                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>

    <div id="Comoros" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="com_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'com_poi')" />
            <label for="com_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="com_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Foreign – full spread</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic Passport – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (CARTE NATIONALE D'IDENTITE) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="com_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'com_poa')" />
            <label for="com_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="com_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                    <li2>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>

                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    </li2>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    </li2>

    <div id="CotedIvoire" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="civo_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'civo_poi')" />
            <label for="civo_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="civo_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (Carte Nationale d'Identité) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Carte d’assuré – front side</li>
                        <li>Carte D'Identite Scolaire – front side</li>
                        <li>Attestation d'Identite – back side required</li>
                        <li>Voter ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Consul ID – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License - back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit - back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="civo_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'civo_poa')" />
            <label for="civo_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="civo_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    </li2>

                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>

                        <li>OSOBNA ISKAZNICA (old) – front side</li>

                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>

                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>

    <div id="Cyprus" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="cyp_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'cyp_poi')" />
            <label for="cyp_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="cyp_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Διαβατήριο / Pasaport (Passport) – full spread</li>
                    <li>Δελτίου Ταυτότητας / Kimlik kartı (ID card) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Άδεια Οδήγησης / Ehliyet (Driving license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="cyp_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'cyp_poa')" />
            <label for="cyp_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="cyp_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

    <div id="Czechia" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="cze_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'cze_poi')" />
            <label for="cze_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="cze_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Cestovní průkaz totožnosti (Passport) – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Cestovni prukaz totoznosti – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Cestovní doklad pro uprchlíky (Refugee travel document) – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Občanský průkaz (Identity card) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatický průkaz (Diplomatic ID) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Průkaz ZTP/P (Disabled person ID) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Doklad o azylu (Refugee ID) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Zbrojní průkaz (Firearms license) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Řidičský průkaz (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Povolení k pobytu (Residence permit) – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="cze_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'cze_poa')" />

    <div id="Denmark" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="dnk_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'dnk_poi')" />
            <label for="dnk_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="dnk_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Pas (Passport) – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Emergency Passport (nødpas) - biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>IDENTITETSKORT (ID card) - front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Militært identitetskort (Army / Military ID Card) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Legitimationskort – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Kørekort (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Opholdstilladelse (Residence permit) – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="dnk_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'dnk_poa')" />

    <div id="DR_Congo" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="cod_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'cod_poi')" />
            <label for="cod_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="cod_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passeport (Passport) – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Laissez-Passer (Emergency travel document) – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Ancien passeport diplomatique (Old diplomatic passort) – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Carte d'Identité Consulaire (Consul ID) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Carte d'électeur (Voter ID) – front side</li>
                    <li>Permis de Conduire (Driver license) – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="cod_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'cod_poa')" />
            <label for="cod_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="cod_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

    <div id="DominicanRepublic" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="dom_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'dom_poi')" />
            <label for="dom_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="dom_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Pasaporte (Passport) – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>CÉDULA DE IDENTIDAD (ID card) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Voter card – front side</li>
                        <li>Identificación Consular (Consul ID) – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Licencia de Conduci (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Cedula de identidad y electoral para extranjeros (Residence permit) – front side</li>
                    <li>Residencia temporal ordinaria / RT-9 (Temporary ordinary residence) – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="dom_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'dom_poa')" />
            <label for="dom_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>

            <label for="ecu_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ecu_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Pasaporte (Passport) – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Pasaporte diplomático (Diplomatic passport) – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Cédula de Identidad (National identity card) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Identificación Consular (Consul ID) – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Licencia de Conduci (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Permiso de Residencia (Residence permit) – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="egy_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'egy_poi')" />
            <label for="egy_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="egy_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Travel Document for Palestinian Refugees – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required (in some cases, notarized translation is required)</li>
                    <li>Pilot License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="egy_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'egy_poa')" />
            <label for="egy_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="egy_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>

            <label for="slv_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="slv_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (Documento Único de Identidad) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="cnq_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'cnq_poi')" />
            <label for="cnq_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="cnq_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (DOCUMENTO DE IDENTIDAD PERSONAL) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="cnq_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'cnq_poa')" />
            <label for="cnq_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>

                <ul>
                    <li>Pass (Passport) – biodata page only</li>

                    <li>ISIKUTUNNISTUS (ID card) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Juhiluba (Driver's license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Elamisluba (Residence permit) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic ID (DIPLOMAATILINE ISIKUTUNNISTUS) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>

    <div id="Ethiopia" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="eth_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'eth_poi')" />
            <label for="eth_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="eth_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Alien's Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Service Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID card:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Addis Ababa City Resident ID Card (የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ የነዋሪ መታወቂያ ካርድ) – front side (in some cases, notarized translation is required)</li>
                        <li>Foreign Nationals of Ethiopian Origin ID / በትውልድ ኢትዮጵያዊ የውጭ ዜጋ መታወቂያ – front side</li>
                        <li>Addis Ababa ID (please contact us)</li>
                        <ul>
                            <li>Kirkos – back side required</li>
                            <li>Bole – back side required</li>
                        </ul>
                        <li>Amhara ID (please contact us)</li>
                        <ul>
                            <li>Weldiya – back side required</li>
                            <li>Bahir Dar – back side required</li>
                            <li>Shewa Robit – front side</li>
                        </ul>
                        <li>Central Ethiopia Regional State ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Deegaanka Soomaalida ID (please contact us)</li>
                        <ul>
                            <li>Jigjiga – front side</li>
                            <li>Dhagax buur – front side</li>
                        </ul>
                        <li>Dire Dawa ID (please contact us) – front side</li>
                        <li>Harari Region ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Oromiyaa ID – back side required</li>
                        <ul>
                            <li>Diksisee – (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                            <li>Naqamtee – (please contact us) – front side</li>
                            <li>Sandafaa – (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                            <li>Kercha – (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                            <li>Kormaa – (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                            <li>Duukam – (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                            <li>Wenchi Shewa – (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                            <li>Haramayaa – (please contact us) – front side</li>
                            <li>Baabbile – (please contact us) – front side</li>
                            <li>Moojoo (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                            <li>Jimma ID – front side</li>
                            <li>Gambela Region ID – front side</li>
                        </ul>
                        <li>Sidaamu Qoqqowo ID</li>
                        <ul>
                            <li>Haweela Tula - (please contact us) – front side</li>
                        </ul>
                        <li>Southern Nations ID</li>
                        <ul>
                            <li>Dilla City – (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                            <li>Aleta Wendo – (please contact us) – front side</li>
                        </ul>
                        <li>Refugee ID Card (የስደተኛ መታወቂያ ካርድ) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Military ID (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Tax ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Temporary ID (please contact us) – front side</li>
                        <li>Fayda digital ID – front side, digital version supported</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side (in some cases, notarized translation is required)</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="eth_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'eth_poa')" />
            <label for="eth_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="eth_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Addis Ababa City Resident ID Card. Contact us.
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Amhara ID. Contact us.
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Deegaanka Soomaalida ID. Contact us.
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Dire Dawa ID. Contact us.
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Oromiyaa ID. Contact us.
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Southern Nations ID. Contact us.
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax ID
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Driver license (if address is indicated). May need translation.
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We do not accept the following documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Old government-issued correspondence (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Old bank statements (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Old utility bills linked to the property (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Pension statements
                    </li2>

    <div id="Finland" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="fin_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'fin_poi')" />
            <label for="fin_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="fin_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passi / Pass (Passport) – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (HENKILÖKORTTI)</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Blue - back side required</li>
                        <li>Green - front side</li>
                        <li>Minor's ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Reservist Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Temporary ID (VALIAIKAINEN HENKILÖKORTTI) - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Pahvinen Ajokortti (Cardboard License) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="fin_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'fin_poa')" />
            <label for="fin_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="fin_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

    <div id="France" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="fra_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'fra_poi')" />
            <label for="fra_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="fra_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Emergency Passport – full spread</li>
                        <li>Travel Document for Refugee – full spread</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Service Passport – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID card (Carte Nationale d'Identite) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Army / Military ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Carte Individuelle d'Admission a l'Aide Médicale de l'Etat – front side</li>
                        <li>Gendarmerie Nationale – back side required</li>
                        <li>ATTESTATION DE DEMANDE D'ASILE - front side</li>
                        <li>Familles Nombreuses - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>DCEM Minor Permit - back side required</li>
                        <li>Récépissé (Renewal Receipt) – front side</li>
                        <li>Attestation de Demande d'Asile – front side</li>
                        <li>Récépissé Constatant la Reconnaissance Dune Protection Internationale – front side</li>
                        <li>Autorisation Provisoire de Sejour – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="fra_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'fra_poa')" />
            <label for="fra_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="fra_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>
                        Residence permit card
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        Residence permit renewal receipt

                    <li2>

                        Temporary residence permit

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We do not accept the following documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Pension statements
                    </li2>

    <div id="Gabon" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="gab_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'gab_poi')" />
            <label for="gab_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="gab_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (Carte Nationale d'Identité) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Consul ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Demande de Carte Nationale D'Identite – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="gab_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'gab_poa')" />

    <div id="Gambia" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="gmb_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'gmb_poi')" />
            <label for="gmb_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="gmb_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (ECOWAS_IDENTITY_CARD) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>ECOWAS ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Non Gambian ID - front side</li>
                        <li>Health Insurance ID - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="gmb_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'gmb_poa')" />
            <label for="gmb_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="gmb_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>

    <div id="Ghana" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="gha_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'gha_poi')" />
            <label for="gha_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="gha_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Minor's Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Refugee Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Dual Citizenship ID card – front side</li>
                        <li>National Health Insurance card – front side</li>
                        <li>Refugee ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Social ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Consular ID – front side</li>
                        <li>ECOWAS ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Voter ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Non-Citizen ID Card – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="gha_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'gha_poa')" />
            <label for="gha_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="gha_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

    <div id="Greece" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="grc_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'grc_poi')" />
            <label for="grc_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="grc_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Service Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>ΔΕΛΤΙΟ ΤΑΥΤΟΤΗΤΑΣ old version - back side required</li>
                        <li>ΔΕΛΤΙΟ ΤΑΥΤΟΤΗΤΑΣ new version - back side required</li>
                        <li>Army / Military ID Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Air force ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Marine ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Fire corps ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>National defence ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Refugee ID – front side</li>
                        <li>International Protection Applicant Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Police ID (ΔΕΛΤΙΟ ΤΑΥΤΟΤΗΤΑΣ) - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="grc_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'grc_poa')" />
            <label for="grc_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="grc_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>

    <div id="Grenada" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="grd_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'grd_poi')" />
            <label for="grd_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="grd_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>National Insurance Card – front side</li>
                    <li>Voter ID – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Insurance ID (National Insurance Scheme) - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="grd_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'grd_poa')" />
            <label for="grd_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="grd_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>

    <div id="Guatemala" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="gtm_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'gtm_poi')" />
            <label for="gtm_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="gtm_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (DPI) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Consular ID – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="gtm_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'gtm_poa')" />
            <label for="gtm_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="gtm_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

    <div id="Guernsey" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ggy_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'ggy_poi')" />
            <label for="ggy_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ggy_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>Citizencard, Totum ID, Young Scot – front side</li>

    <div id="GuineaBissau" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="gnb_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'gnb_poi')" />
            <label for="gnb_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="gnb_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (BILHETE DE IDENTIDADE) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>ECOWAS ID – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="gnb_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'gnb_poa')" />
            <label for="gnb_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="gnb_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    </li2>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                </ul2>

    <div id="Guyana" class="info">

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="guy_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'guy_poi')" />
            <label for="guy_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="guy_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card – front side</li>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>

            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="hti_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (CARTE D'IDENTIFICATION NATIONALE) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit (Permis de séjour) – biodata page only</li>
                </ul>
            </div>
