    <div id="Honduras" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="hnd_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'hnd_poi')" />
            <label for="hnd_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="hnd_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (DOCUMENTO NACIONAL DE IDENTIFICACIÓN) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Consul ID – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="hnd_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'hnd_poa')" />
            <label for="hnd_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="hnd_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

    <div id="Iceland" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="isl_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'isl_poi')" />
            <label for="isl_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="isl_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>NAFNSKÍRTEINI travel document – back side required</li>
                        <li>NAFNSKÍRTEINI – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="isl_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'isl_poa')" />
            <label for="isl_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="isl_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>

                    </li2>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>

    <div id="India" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ind_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'ind_poi')" />
            <label for="ind_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ind_poi">
                <blockquote>
                    <p>In India, the Aadhaar number is hidden in the Dashboard for <a href="/docs/no-document-verification">Non-Doc Verification</a> checks.</p>
                </blockquote>
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Overseas Citizen of India Certificate of Registration – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Aadhaar – front side</li>
                        <li>Ex Servicemen ID Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Border Police Force ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Central Government Health Scheme ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Indian Armed Forces Civilian Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Islanders Identity Card (Andaman and Nicobar) – front side</li>
                        <li>Permanent Account Number Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Post Office ID Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Resident Identity Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Tax ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Voter ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Ration Card – front side</li>
                        <li>e-SHRAM Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Professional ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>ECHS card – front side</li>
                       
                        <li>Government ID:</li>
                        <ul>
                            <li>Himachal Pradesh – back side required</li>
                            <li>Manipur – back side required</li>
                            <li>Delhi – front side</li>
                            <li>New Delhi – front side</li>
                            <li>Uttar Pradesh – front side</li>
                            <li>Arunachal Pradesh – back side required</li>
                            <li>Nagaland – front side</li>
                        </ul>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Andhra State DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Arunachal State DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Assam State DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Bihar State DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Chandigarh State DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Chhattisgarh State DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Delhi state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>DHN & DD (U.T) DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Goa State DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Gujarat State DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Haryana State DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Hoshiarpur State DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Booklet DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Indian Union DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Jalandhar State DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Jammu and Kashmir state DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Jharkhand state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Karnataka state DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Kerala state DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Madhya state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Maharashtra state DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Manipur state DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Meghalaya state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Mizoram state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Nagaland state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Odisha (Orissa) state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Pondicherry (Puducherry) state DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Punjab state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Rajasthan state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Sikkim state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Tamil Nadu state DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Tripura state DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Telangana state DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Uttar state DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>West Bengal state DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Central Motor Vehicles – back side required</li>
                        <li>Union of India DL – back side required</li>
                        <li>Uttarakhand DL – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ind_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'ind_poa')" />
            <label for="ind_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ind_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>

    <div id="Indonesia" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="idn_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'idn_poi')" />
            <label for="idn_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="idn_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Service Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic Passport – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Kartu Tanda Penduduk (KTP) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Surat Keterangan – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Limited Stay Permit Card – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="idn_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'idn_poa')" />
            <label for="idn_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="idn_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>

    <div id="Iran" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="irn_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'irn_poi')" />
            <label for="irn_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="irn_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Pilgrimage Passport - biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (کارت شناسائی ملی) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>End-of-Service Smart Card (please contact us) – front side</li>
                        <li>Shenasnameh Card (please contact us) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License (please contact us) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Motorcycle DL (please contact us) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit (please contact us) – front side</li>
                    <li>Refugee ID (please contact us) – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="irn_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'irn_poa')" />
            <label for="irn_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="irn_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We do not accept the following documents:</p></div>

    <div id="Iraq" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="irq_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'irq_poi')" />
            <label for="irq_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="irq_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>ID Card (كارتى نيشتماني) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Booklet ID (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Voter ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Refugee ID (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Ministry Of Interior ID - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>DL in form of plastic card (please contact us) – front side</li>
                        <li>DL in form of plastic card with MRZ – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required (in some cases, notarized translation is required)</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="irq_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'irq_poa')" />
            <label for="irq_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>

            <label for="isr_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="isr_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Provisional Passport – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (תעודת זהות) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Army / Military ID Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Judea and Samaria State Card – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Operator’s (Skipper’s) certificate – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit (Conditional Release 2(a)5 visa – front side, acceptable only if the owner’s photo is present</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="isr_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'isr_poa')" />

    <div id="Italy" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ita_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'ita_poi')" />
            <label for="ita_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ita_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>Travel document – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (CARTA DI IDENTITÀ) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Army / Military ID Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Booklet ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Tessera Sanitaria (please contact us) - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <ul>

    <div id="Japan" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="jpn_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'jpn_poi')" />
            <label for="jpn_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="jpn_poi">
                <blockquote>
                    <p>
                        In Japan, the number on My Number Card is not extracted and masked on the document image. If you have a legal obligation or permission to collect the My Number Card that is normally masked, you can uncheck the
                        <b>Details ought to be blurred</b> checkbox in the <a href="/docs/customize-supported-id-documents#customize-extraction-process">Supported ID documents</a> settings.
                    </p>
                </blockquote>
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>日本旅券 (Japanese passport) – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>再入国許可 (Re-entry Permit) – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (個人番号 力一下)</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>マイナンバーカード (顔写真付き) (My Number Card, with photo) – front side</li>
                        <li>陸上自衛隊職員証 (Ground Self-Defense Force Personnel card) – back side required</li>
                        <li>宅地建物取引士資格証 (Residential Land and Building Trader Certificate) – front side</li>
                        <li>無線従事者免許証 (Radio operator license) - front side</li>
                        <li>身体障害者手帳 (Disability certificate) - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>運転免許証 (Driver license) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>仮運転免許 (Provisional driver license) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Driving Experience Certificate - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>在留カード (Zairyi card) – back side required</li>
                        <li>住民票 (Basic resident registration card) – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="jpn_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'jpn_poa')" />
            <label for="jpn_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="jpn_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>

                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills

                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                    <li2>

                        </svg>

                    <li2>

    <div id="Jersey" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="jey_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'jey_poi')" />
            <label for="jey_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="jey_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card – no National ID:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Citizencard, Totum ID, Young Scot – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="jey_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'jey_poa')" />
            <label for="jey_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="jey_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                    </li2>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ken_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'ken_poi')" />
            <label for="ken_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ken_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>East African Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Travel document - biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>National ID Card – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Huduma Namba card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Military ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Refugee ID – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <label for="kir_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="kir_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>

    <div id="Kyrgyzstan" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="kgz_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'kgz_poi')" />
            <label for="kgz_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="kgz_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (ИДЕНТИФИКАЦИЯЛЫК КАРТА) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Passport Card – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit - full spread</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="kgz_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'kgz_poa')" />
            <label for="kgz_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="kgz_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>

                        </svg>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>

                <ul2>

    <div id="Lebanon" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="lbn_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'lbn_poi')" />
            <label for="lbn_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="lbn_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>ID Card (بطاقة هوية ) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Refugee ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Consul ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Military ID - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Laminated paper card (please contact us) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required (some may require notarized translation)</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="lbn_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'lbn_poa')" />

            <label for="lso_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="lso_poi">

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="lby_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'lby_poi')" />
            <label for="lby_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="lby_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card ( بطاقة شخصية) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License (please contact us) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>First Grade DL (please contact us) – front side</li>
                        <li>Second Grade DL (please contact us) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

    <div id="Luxembourg" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="lux_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'lux_poi')" />
            <label for="lux_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="lux_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>Personalausweis (Identity card) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Führerschein (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Aufenthaltserlaubnis (Resident permit) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Titre / Carte de Sejour - back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="lux_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'lux_poa')" />
            <label for="lux_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="lux_poa">

                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>

                    <li>Permis de Conduire (Driver license) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Permis de Conduire en Livret (Driver license in Booklet Form) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Titre de Séjour (Residence permit) – back side required</li>
                </ul>

    <div id="Malawi" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="mwi_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'mwi_poi')" />
            <label for="mwi_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="mwi_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (Chiphaso cha Nzika) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>ASYLUM SEEKER ID - front side</li>
                        <li>Refugee ID - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="mwi_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'mwi_poa')" />
            <label for="mwi_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>

    <div id="Malaysia" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="mys_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'mys_poi')" />
            <label for="mys_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="mys_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Pasport (Passport) – full spread</li>
                    <li>Kad Pengenalan / MyKad (Identity card) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>MyKAS Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Kad tentera (Military ID) – front side</li>
                        <li>MyRC - front side</li>
                        <li>Dokumen Pengenalan Sementara - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Lesen memandu (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Lesen memandu pembelajaran (Learner’s DL) – front side, should be accompanied by expiry date slip</li>
                        <li>Lesen vokasional (Vocational License) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Pas lawatan tetap (Residence permit) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Pas pelajar (Student pass) – front side</li>
                        <li>Pas perkhidmatan permit kerja (Work permit service card) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="mys_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'mys_poa')" />
            <label for="mys_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="mys_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Kad Pengenalan
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                        Kad Pengenalan Angkatan Tentera Malaysia
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Refugee ID (MyRC)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Driving licence
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Residence permit
                    </li2>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Student Pass
                    </li2>
                </ul2>

    <div id="Malta" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="mlt_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'mlt_poi')" />
            <label for="mlt_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="mlt_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passaport (Passport) – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>Karta Tal-Identita (Identity card) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>KARTA TA' L-IDENTITÀ - back side required</li>
                        <li>Karta tal-Profug (Refugee ID) – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Liċenzja tas-Sewqan (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>Permess ta' Residenza (Residence permit) – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="mlt_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'mlt_poa')" />
            <label for="mlt_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="mlt_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                    </li2>

    <div id="Mauritania" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="mrt_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'mrt_poi')" />
            <label for="mrt_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="mrt_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (بطاقة تعريف) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="mrt_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'mrt_poa')" />
            <label for="mrt_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="mrt_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                    </li2>
