                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Receipts for purchases
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Insurance statements

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Documents stating PO Box addresses

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Envelopes and parcels showing your name and an address
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />

                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

    <div id="Philippines" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="phl_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'phl_poi')" />
            <label for="phl_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="phl_poi">
                <blockquote>
                    <p>In the Philippines, the bank card details are not extracted and masked on Multi-Purpose ID.</p>
                </blockquote>
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Green Passport Old – full spread</li>
                        <li>Maritime Passport – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Unified Multi-Purpose ID Card (UMID) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>PhilHealth ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Postal ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Social Security ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Tax ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Armed Forces ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>National Bureau of Investigation ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Senior Citizen ID – front side</li>
                        <li>National Police ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Police Clearance ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Barangay ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Persons With Disability ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>DSWD Card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Veterans Affairs Office ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Bureau of Fire Protection – back side required</li>
                        <li>Voter's certification – back side required</li>
                        <li>Bureau of Jail Management and Penology ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Solo Parent ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Pambansang Pagkakakilanlan – front side</li>
                        <li>Citizen Card - front side</li>
                        <li>Resident's ID - front side</li>
                        <li>PHILIPPINE COAST GUARD ID - back side required</li>
                        <li>Community Identification Card - back side required</li>
                        <li>Private Security ID - back side required</li>
                        <li>Pambansang Pagkakakilanlan (ePhilID) – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary license - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Student Permit – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Alien Certificate of Registration – back side required</li>
                        <li>Philippine Retirement Authority – back side required</li>
                        <li>Alien Employment Permit – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="phl_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'phl_poa')" />
            <label for="phl_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="phl_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Driver license
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Armed Forces of the Philippines ID
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Philippine Military Academy ID
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Philippine Coast Guard ID
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Barangay ID
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Barangay Resident ID
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Community ID
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax ID
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        QCitizen ID (Citizen Card)

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                    <li2>

                    <li2>

            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="pcn_poi">

            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="pcn_poa">

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    </li2>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

    <div id="Poland" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="pol_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'pol_poi')" />
            <label for="pol_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="pol_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Travel document – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (DOWOD OSOBISTY) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Karta Polaka – back side required</li>
                        <li>Military ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Special ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Tymczasowe zaświadczenie tożsamości cudzoziemca - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Zezwolenie mały ruch graniczny – back side required</li>
                        <li>Tymczasowego Zaświadczenia Tożsamości Cudzoziemca - back side required</li>
                        <li>Dokument potwierdzający prawo stałego pobytu - back side required</li>
                        <li>Zezwolenie na przekraczanie granicy w ramach małego ruchu granicznego - back side required</li>
                        <li>Zaświadczenie o zarejestrowaniu pobytu obywatela UE - back side required</li>
                        <li>Dokument potwierdzający prawo stałego pobytu - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="pol_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'pol_poa')" />
            <label for="pol_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="pol_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        ID Card (Dowód Osobisty)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Driver license
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Karta pobytu
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Dokument potwierdzający prawo stałego pobytu
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Zezwolenie na przekraczanie granicy w ramach małego ruchu granicznego
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Zaświadczenie o zarejestrowaniu pobytu obywatela UE
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Dokument potwierdzający prawo stałego pobytu
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Zaświadczenia o zarejestrowaniu pobytu
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of residence (Poświadczenie zamieszkania)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Vehicle registration certificate
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Information about registration for permanent residence (Informacja o zameldowaniu na pobyt stały)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Social Security, My data statements (ZUS/Zakład Ubezpieczeń Społecznych, Moje dane)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate from the PESEL register (Zaświadczenie z rejestru PESEL)
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We do not accept the following documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Old government-issued correspondence (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Old bank statements (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Old utility bills linked to the property (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Pension statements
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Insurance policies
                    </li2>

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Medical bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Receipts for purchases
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Insurance statements
                    </li2>

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="prt_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'prt_poi')" />
            <label for="prt_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="prt_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (CARTÃO DE CIDADÃO) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>BILHETE DE IDENTIDADE DE CIDADÃO NACIONAL - back side required</li>
                        <li>CARTÃO DE IDENTIDADE DIPLOMÁTICO - back side required</li>
                        <li>Refugee ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Provisional Citizen Card – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>CARTÃO DE RESIDÊNCIA PERMANENTE – back side required</li>
                        <li>EU citizen family member card – back side required</li>
                        <li>Permanent Residence EU Citizen card – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="prt_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'prt_poa')" />

    <div id="Qatar" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="qat_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'qat_poi')" />
            <label for="qat_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="qat_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic - biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (بطاقة إثبات شخصية) – back side required, digital version supported</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side, digital version supported</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="qat_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'qat_poa')" />

    <div id="SouthAfrica" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="zaf_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'zaf_poi')" />
            <label for="zaf_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="zaf_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport — biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Refugee Travel Document — biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Smart ID Card — front side</li>
                        <li>Green bar-coded Identity book — front side</li>
                        <li>Refugee Booklet — front side</li>
                        <li>Temporary ID — front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Asylum Seeker Temporary Permit — front side</li>
                        <li>Formal Recognition of Refugee — front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="zaf_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'zaf_poa')" />
            <label for="zaf_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="zaf_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Passport
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        ID Card (Booklet ID)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Asylum seeker temporary permit
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Angor (Real Estate Agency Statement)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Residence conformation from local municipality
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Motor vehicle licence and licence disc
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Provisional registration (SACE)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Notice of registration (SARS)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>

    <div id="Romania" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="rou_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'rou_poi')" />
            <label for="rou_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="rou_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Refugee document – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Temporary Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (CARTE D'IDENTITE) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>CARD DE IDENTITATE DIPLOMATICĂ - back side required</li>
                        <li>Provisional ID – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Permis De Mic Trafic De Frontiera – back side required</li>
                        <li>Carte de Rezidenţă Permanentă - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="rou_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'rou_poa')" />
            <label for="rou_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="rou_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Provisional ID
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Driver license (issued from 1995)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Residence card for family members
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Permis de ședere
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Permanent residence card
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Permisele de mic trafic de frontiera
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Permanent residence card for EU citizens
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of tax registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We do not accept the following documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>

    <div id="Russia" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="rus_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'rus_poi')" />
            <label for="rus_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="rus_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Internal – full spread</li>
                        <li>Foreign – full spread</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic – full spread</li>
                        <li>Service – full spread</li>
                        <li>Refugee – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Army / Military ID – back side</li>
                        <li>Temporary Certificate – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="rus_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'rus_poa')" />
            <label for="rus_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="rus_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Travel Passport (with registration stamp)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Internal Passport (with registration stamp)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Temporary identity certificate
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Driver Card (Карта водителя)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tractor Driving Licence
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Residence permit of a foreign citizen
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Residence permit of a stateless person
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Vehicle registration certificate
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Foreing Citizen/Stateless Person arrival notification
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Marital status reference (Справка о семейном положении)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of family composition (Справка о составе семьи)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Сertificate of registration, form № 3
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of residence, form № 8
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Temporary residence application
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We do not accept the following documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Old government-issued correspondence (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Old bank statements (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Old utility bills linked to the property (older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Pension statements
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path d="M8 8.91747L12.0825 13L13 12.0825L8.91747 8L13 3.91747L12.0825 3L8 7.08253L3.91747 3L3 3.91747L7.08253 8L3 12.0825L3.91747 13L8 8.91747Z" fill="#D9534F" />
                        </svg>
                        Insurance policies
                    </li2>
