    <div id="SaintVincentGrenadines" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="vct_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'vct_poi')" />
            <label for="vct_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="vct_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="vct_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'vct_poa')" />
            <label for="vct_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="vct_poa">

    <div id="Samoa" class="info">

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="wsm_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'wsm_poi')" />
            <label for="wsm_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="wsm_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>ID Card – front side</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="wsm_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'wsm_poa')" />
            <label for="wsm_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="wsm_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                    </li2>

            <label for="sau_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="sau_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Special Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (بطاقة الهوية الوطنية) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>ID Card (please contact us) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Saudi Premium Residence – front side</li>
                      <li>Residence permit (please contact us) – front side</li>
                      <li>Digital versions of documents</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Passport</li>
                        <li>ID Card</li>
                        <li>Residence Permit</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="syc_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'syc_poi')" />
            <label for="syc_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="syc_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card – front side</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="syc_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'syc_poa')" />

            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="syc_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

    <div id="Singapore" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="sgp_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'sgp_poi')" />
            <label for="sgp_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="sgp_poi">
                <blockquote>
                    <p>
                        In Singapore, the NRIC, FIN, birth certificate number, passport number, and work permit number are not extracted and masked on the images of the relevant documents. If you have a legal obligation or permission to
                        collect the details of the aforementioned documents that are normally masked, you can uncheck the <b>Details ought to be blurred</b> checkbox in the
                        <a href="/docs/customize-supported-id-documents#customize-extraction-process">Supported ID documents</a> settings.
                    </p>
                </blockquote>
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Home Team National Service Identity Card – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Employment Pass – back side required</li>
                        <li>Work Permit – back side required</li>
                        <li>Student's Pass – back side required</li>
                        <li>Dependant's Pass – back side required</li>
                        <li>EntrePass – back side required</li>
                        <li>S PASS – back side required</li>
                        <li>Personalised Employment Pass – back side required</li>
                        <li>Training Employment Pass – back side required</li>
                        <li>Overseas Networks and Expertise Pass (ONE Pass) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Work Holiday Pass – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="sgp_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'sgp_poa')" />
            <label for="sgp_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="sgp_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="sxm_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'sxm_poi')" />
            <label for="sxm_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="sxm_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (Identiteitskaart) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>

    <div id="Slovakia" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="svk_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'svk_poi')" />
            <label for="svk_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="svk_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport - biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Travel document - biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (Občianske preukazy) - back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>ZBROJNÝ PREUKAZ - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License - front side</li>
                    <li>Paper card - back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit - back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="svk_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'svk_poa')" />
            <label for="svk_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="svk_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                </ul2>

    <div id="Somalia" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="som_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'som_poi')" />
            <label for="som_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="som_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (WARAQADDA AQOONSIGA) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Jubaland ID – front side</li>
                        <li>NIRA National ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Mogadishu ID – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="som_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'som_poa')" />
            <label for="som_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="som_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

    <div id="SouthKorea" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="kor_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'kor_poi')" />
            <label for="kor_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="kor_poi">
                <blockquote>
                    <p>
                        In South Korea, the RRN, the alien registration number and identity document number are not extracted and masked on the images of the relevant documents. If you have a legal obligation or permission to collect the
                        details of the aforementioned documents that are normally masked, you can uncheck the <b>Details ought to be blurred</b> checkbox in the
                        <a href="/docs/customize-supported-id-documents#customize-extraction-process">Supported ID documents</a> settings.
                    </p>
                </blockquote>
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>여권 (Passport) – full spread</li>
                    <li>비상 여권 (Emergency passport) – full spread</li>
                    <li>주민등록증 (Identity card) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>미성년자 신분증 (Minor’s ID) – front side</li>
                        <li>Korean ID card (Consular ID) – front side</li>
                        <li>복지카드 (Welfare card) – front side</li>
                        <li>Temporary ID (민등록증 발급신청 확인서) - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>운전면허증 (Driver license) – front side</li>
                    <li>체류자격증 (Residence permit) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Permanent resident - back side required</li>
                        <li>Overseas Korean resident card - back side required</li>
                        <li>Alien registration card - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="kor_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'kor_poa')" />
            <label for="kor_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="kor_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    <li2>

                        Driver license

                        </svg>
                        Residence permit (Overseas Korean)

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of Alien Registration (외국인등록 사실증명)

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

    <div id="SriLanka" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="lka_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'lka_poi')" />
            <label for="lka_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="lka_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (ජාතික හැඳුනුම්පත) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Paper ID (translation required) – back side required</li>
                        <li>Military ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Adult Identity card (translation required) – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Learners Permit – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="lka_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'lka_poa')" />
            <label for="lka_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="lka_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        ID Card (plastic)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        ID Card (paper - contact us)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Adult Identity Card (contact us)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Driving licence
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Learner Permit
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Temporary Driving Licence
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Vehicle revenue licence
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bankbook
                    </li2>

    <div id="Sudan" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="sdn_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'sdn_poi')" />
            <label for="sdn_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="sdn_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Refugee – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (بطاقة إثبات الشخصية) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License (please contact us) - back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="sdn_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'sdn_poa')" />
            <label for="sdn_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="sdn_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                    <li2>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

    <div id="Sweden" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="swe_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'swe_poi')" />
            <label for="swe_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="swe_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Emergency Passport – full spread</li>
                        <li>Diplomatic Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Aliens Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (NATIONELLT IDENTITETSKORT) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Tax ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Identitetskort – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="swe_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'swe_poa')" />
            <label for="swe_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="swe_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

    <div id="Switzerland" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="che_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'che_poi')" />
            <label for="che_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="che_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (IDENTITATSKARTE) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic ID – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <ul>

    <div id="Taiwan" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="twn_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'twn_poi')" />
            <label for="twn_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="twn_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>ID Card (中華民國國民身分證) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>National Health Insurance – front side</li>
                        <li>Certificate of disability (中華民國身心障礙證明) - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="twn_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'twn_poa')" />
            <label for="twn_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="twn_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>

                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>

    <div id="Thailand" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="tha_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'tha_poi')" />
            <label for="tha_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="tha_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Border Passport – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Emergency Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (บัตรประจำตัวประชาชน) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Army ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Card for not registered – front side</li>
                        <li>Persons with Disabilities ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Radio Operator License – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Public Vehicle DL – front side</li>
                        <li>Life Time DL – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Work Permit – back side required</li>
                        <li>Thailand Pink Thai ID - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="tha_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'tha_poa')" />
            <label for="tha_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="tha_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>

                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                    </li2>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>

    <div id="TurksCaicosIslands" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="tca_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'tca_poi')" />
            <label for="tca_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="tca_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card – front side</li>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="tca_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'tca_poa')" />
            <label for="tca_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="tca_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                    </li2>

    <div id="Tonga" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ton_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'ton_poi')" />
            <label for="ton_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ton_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>ID Card (KAATI ID FAKAFONUA) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ton_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'ton_poa')" />
            <label for="ton_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ton_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>

                    </li2>

                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>

    <div id="Turkey" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="tur_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'tur_poi')" />
            <label for="tur_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="tur_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (TÜRKİYE CUMHURİYETİ KİMLİK KARTI) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Diplomatic ID – back side required</li>
                        <li>Gecici Koruma Kimlik Belgesi – front side</li>
                        <li>Uluslararasi Koruma Basvuru Sahibi Kimlik Belgesi – front side</li>
                        <li>Blue Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Blue Card (plastic) - back side required</li>
                        <li>Engelliler İçin Kimlik Kartı - back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Work Permit – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="tur_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'tur_poa')" />
            <label for="tur_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="tur_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>
                        Vehicle registration certificate
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We do not accept the following documents:</p></div>

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="uga_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'uga_poi')" />
            <label for="uga_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="uga_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>East African Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Refugee ID - back side required</li>
                        <li>Voter Location Slip – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="uga_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'uga_poa')" />
            <label for="uga_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="uga_poa">

    <div id="Ukraine" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ukr_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'ukr_poi')" />
            <label for="ukr_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ukr_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary Certificate of Citizenship – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Travel Document of Person Granted Complementary Protection – biodata page only</li>
                        <li>Internal old passport (at request) – full spread</li>
                        <li>Foreign – full spread</li>
                        <li>Refugee Document for Travelling Abroad – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card (ПАСПОРТ ГРОМАДЯНИНА УКРАЇНИ) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Army ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Pension Certificate – front side</li>
                        <li>АКРЕДИТАЦІЙНА КАРТКА - front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                        <li>Permanent Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                        <li>Refugee – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ukr_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'ukr_poa')" />
            <label for="ukr_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ukr_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>

                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Договір купівлі-продажу квартири

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                    <li2>
                        <svg class="iconred" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

    <div id="USVirginIslands" class="info">

        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="vir_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'vir_poi')" />
            <label for="vir_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="vir_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>ID Card – front side</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Temporary DL – back side required</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="vir_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'vir_poa')" />
