            <label for="ury_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ury_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <li>ID Card (Cédula de identidad) – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – back side required</li>

    <div id="USA" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="usa_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'usa_poi')" />
            <label for="usa_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="usa_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Emergency Passport – full spread</li>
                        <li>Refugee Travel Document – full spread</li>
                        <li>Seafarer’s – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Alabama ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Alabama, Perry County Pistol Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Alabama, State of Alabama Pistol Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Alabama Voter Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Alabama Pistol Permit – front side</li>
                        <li>Alabama Photo Voter Identification Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Alabama Photo Voter Identification Card Temporary – front side</li>
                        <li>Alaska ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Alaska Curyung Tribal Council ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Arizona ID – front side</li>
                        <li>Arkansas ID – front side</li>
                        <li>California ID – front side</li>
                        <li>California, License to Carry Concealed Pistol – front side</li>
                        <li>California, San Francisco City ID Card – back side required</li>

            <label for="usa_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="usa_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>

    <div id="Uzbekistan" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="uzb_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'uzb_poi')" />
            <label for="uzb_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="uzb_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Internal (green) passport – full spread</li>
                        <li>Foreign (claret) passport – full spread</li>
                        <li>Certificate of Return to Uzbekistan – biodata page only</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card – back side required</li>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Persons Without Citizenship ID Card – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="uzb_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'uzb_poa')" />
            <label for="uzb_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="uzb_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />

    <div id="Venezuela" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ven_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'ven_poi')" />
            <label for="ven_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ven_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (Cedula De Identidad) – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Carnet de la Patria – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – front side</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="ven_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'ven_poa')" />
            <label for="ven_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="ven_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>

    <div id="Vietnam" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="vnm_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'vnm_poi')" />
            <label for="vnm_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="vnm_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – full spread</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Entry and Exit Permit – full spread</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>ID Card:</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>CĂN CƯỚC – back side required</li>
                        <li>CĂN CƯỚC CÔNG DÂN – back side required</li>
                        <li>CHỨNG MINH NHÂN DÂN – back side required</li>
                        <li>CHỨNG MINH QUÂN NHÂN CHUYÊN NGHIỆP – back side required</li>
                        <li>THẺ HẠ Sĩ GUAN, BINH Sĩ DỰ BỊ – back side required</li>
                        <li>GIẤY CHỨNG MINH SĨ QUAN – back side required</li>
                        <li>THẺ HẠ Sĩ QUAN, BINH SĨ TẠI NGŨ – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <li>Army DL – front side</li>
                    <li>Residence Permit – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Temporary Resident Card – front side</li>
                        <li>Permanent Resident Card – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="vnm_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'vnm_poa')" />
            <label for="vnm_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="vnm_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>

                        </svg>
                        Driver license
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

    <div id="Zambia" class="info">
        <div class="line"></div>
        <form class="tabs">
            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="zmb_poi" checked="checked" onclick="openTab(event, 'zmb_poi')" />
            <label for="zmb_poi" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported ID documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="zmb_poi">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following ID documents:</p></div>
                <ul>
                    <li>Passport – biodata page only</li>
                    <li>ID Card (National Registration Card) – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Voter ID – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Driving License – front side</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Provisional DL – front side</li>
                    </ul>
                    <li>Residence Permit – back side required</li>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Study Permit – back side required</li>
                        <li>Employment Permit – back side required</li>
                        <li>Temporary permit - back side required</li>
                        <li>Commonwealth Registration Card – back side required</li>
                    </ul>
                </ul>
            </div>

            <input type="radio" name="tabs" id="zmb_poa" onclick="openTab(event, 'zmb_poa')" />
            <label for="zmb_poa" style="margin-right: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;">Supported address documents</label>
            <div class="tab tabcontent" id="zmb_poa">
                <div class="font-small-header"><p>In this country, we support the following documents as proof of address:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>
                <ul2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Tax bill (not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Mortgage statement
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Certificate of voter registration
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Correspondence with a government authority regarding the receipt of benefits such as a pension, unemployment benefits, housing benefits, and so on
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Home internet and TV bills
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Landline telephone bill
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Bank statement and correspondence with the date of issue and the name of the person (the document must be not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Utility bill for gas, electricity, water, internet, etc. linked to the property (the document must not be older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        A lease agreement that is current and has the signatures of the landlord and the tenant
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Rent bills issued by a real estate rental agency
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Credit card statement issued by a bank
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Letter from a recognized public authority or public servant (any government-issued correspondence not older than 3 months)
                    </li2>
                    <li2>
                        <svg class="icongreen" viewBox="0 0 16 16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M14 4.80118L6.53044 12L2 7.63378L2.83131 6.8326L6.53044 10.3976L13.1687 4L14 4.80118Z" fill="#50AF51" />
                        </svg>
                        Employer’s certificate for PoA
                    </li2>
                </ul2>
                <div class="font-small-header" style="margin-top: 20px;"><p>We also support the following country-specific documents:</p></div>
                <div style="margin-top: -20px;"></div>

> 📘 Unrecognized regions
>
> Sumsub does not accept passports and driver's licenses issued by Russia in the occupied Ukrainian territories of Crimea, Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kherson regions. Applicants whose PoA indicates settlements located within Crimea, Donetsk, or Luhansk regions are also restricted. We rely on open-source data and our internal investigations to identify such documents and settlements.
>
> Sumsub does not accept identity documents issued by unrecognized governments, including: Abkhazia, South Ossetia, Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, Somaliland, Transnistrian Moldavian Republic, and Nagorno-Karabakh Republic. Proof of address documents issued in above territories are accepted by default, unless restricted per client request.
